The [[Imperial Dragon Hammer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt Dmg]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
: Damage +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
: Health +30
